top_defects: Faces: Tidler has a black visor band + frown (04, c1), Sprigfox eyes are black plus/slash shapes with no highlight = dead eyes (05, c2), avatar has a blue tear-pool under a white bar and a mouth of 3 isolated maroon voxels (06, c3), orange Tidler variant shows blue tear drips (c4); only Puffbun is friendly. Flagship starters/villagers/Minecraft axolotl default to big round eyes with 2 highlights + upturned mouth. Fix: one 5x5-voxel eye template (iris fills eye, 2 tones same hue, 2x2 white highlight upper-left + 1x1 lower-right, #2B1B3F outline top/outer only), Tidler two oval eyes >=2 voxels apart + upturned 5-voxel mouth + cheek blushes, Sprigfox 3x4 oval eyes, avatar smile 3-4 voxels on the axis in skin x0.75, add a face-sheet shot at 1:1 and 64 px.

No grounding or scene lighting: no contact/cast shadow under any creature or the avatar (c5, 01, 02, 11, 12, game_day), flat at golden hour, head-top faces dull mauve and darker than fronts (15), night = flat ultramarine (13, c4). Fix: blob decal r~0.6 x body length, opacity 0.35-0.5, #5B4B8A + creature layer in the sun shadow map (bias 0.0005-0.002, normalBias 0.02-0.05); drive shader from world sun/hemi uniforms with 3-band ramp (edges smoothstepped 8-12%: x1.0 warm, x0.78, x0.55 mixed 25% to #5B4B8A); Fresnel rim pow 3, 0.2-0.3; top faces highest N.L; night ramp toward #5B4B8A/moon #8FB0FF.

Colour speckle and contour noise (brief trap): Sprigfox ears/muzzle grey-orange checkerboards with stray voxels and a grain only on grey voxels (05, c2), cool-mauve voxels interleaved with pink on Puffbun rim (03, 15), fins stuck on as cards (04). Fix: no hue jitter (+/-2-3% lightness only), markings as designed shapes >=2 voxels, orphan-voxel cleanup pass, ears as tapering 3-wide columns with cream inner stripe, fluff only at defined spots, one grain treatment for all colours.

Tidler and Sprigfox silhouettes lack Puffbun's single strong idea: Tidler = teal lump at 64 px (07), flat helmet cap + glued fins (04), rigid horizontal tail ending in a flat red disc in profile so front and side read as two animals (08, states strip #2-#6); Sprigfox = boxy head, stilt legs, crown + checker ears clutter (05). Fix: Tidler ellipsoid head ~7x6x6 with chamfers, body +15% wide, one tapering fin crest fused to the back, tail -40% with round fin; Sprigfox head ~38-40% of body length, legs -20%, 2 clean cone ears, one sprout, S-curve 3-tier plume; gate with black-silhouette renders at 32/64 px.

Glow markings do not glow and night is a hue-swap: cyan ear caps are flat bright blocks with a faint halo, yellow fin glows are flat petals, no light spill on ground/neighbours, no visible pulse by day (13, c4, 02, 03). Fix: emissive 3-4x body luminance + HDR bloom (strength 0.6-0.9, radius ~0.4, threshold ~0.9), ground light decal/point light r 1.2-2 m intensity 0.25-0.4 in marking colour, pulse 0.85-1.15 at 0.4-0.8 Hz keyed to mood, 2-4 night motes per creature, violet-blue night body ramp. Also: pack shots 14 (creatures hidden, 64 px unproven), 16 (island view, no creature, 8 identical frames) and 10 (far camera, states unreadable) do not show what they claim; avatar back view has ring-banded hair dome + pale chevron that reads like a glitch.
